evidence.content: SCENARIO ONLY. This case adds an existing provider to practice-alpha at location-a and location-b. It does not start a new provider enrollment or replace another active affiliation.

evidence.title: Existing provider affiliation record
evidence.content: Provider-alpha already has active affiliation-retained at location-a. Retain this affiliation; this case is additive.

evidence.title: Two-location scope confirmation

requirements.question: Which locations should this request cover?

Preserves the existing affiliation and both target locations
Makes no claim that this synthetic scenario describes actual payer policy
